lines.text: Many learners say: I went in the cinema.
Better: I went to the cinema.
Use to for a place you go to.
To! We went to the park.

data.why: Use to for a place you go to.

native.tip: Идёшь в место — говори “to”: “I went to the cinema”, а не “in”.
native.caption: Ты говоришь “I went in the cinema”? 🙈 По-русски мы говорим «в кино», но по-английски нужно “to”: “I went to the cinema”. Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.

en.tip: When you go to a place, say “to”: “I went to the cinema”, not “in”.
en.caption: Do you say “I went in the cinema”? 🙈 In Russian we say “v kino”, but in English you need “to”: “I went to the cinema”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
